answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened onboarding flow for self-serve SMBs: it improved completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not broadly counter the competitor with discounts: exp_73 showed that a 40% targeted discount lifted signup and short-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, and explicitly cautioned against treating discounting as sustainable growth. The immediate effect on current churn conversations remains unmeasured, so pricing concessions should not be generalized from the available evidence.
